_doc: Copy to credentials.json, fill in the broker(s) you selected in config.broker, then chmod 600. Gitignored. NEVER commit real credentials.

zerodha._doc: Used when data_broker or trade_broker is 'zerodha'. Kite Connect is a paid add-on.

upstox._doc: Used when data_broker or trade_broker is 'upstox'. Tokens expire daily at 03:30 IST. Easiest unattended setup: fill mobile_no + totp_key + pin and install playwright (pip install playwright && playwright install chromium). Otherwise paste a daily access_token, or a fresh auth_code to exchange.
